about.label: About the application
about.title: A hub that turns community match night into organized operations.
about.description: RinhaDasLendas reduces manual coordination in chat, loose spreadsheets, and improvised decisions. The platform keeps player data, route preferences, presence, and draft in one flow so organizers can focus on the match.

2026_07_2.title: Scheduled presence lists
2026_07_2.summary: Moderators can now organize weekly lists with defined times, history tracking, and safe recovery during the configured window.

weekly-presence-scheduling.title: Weekly presence scheduling
weekly-presence-scheduling.description: Create schedules for selected weekdays and let each new list enter the current Discord flow automatically.

publication-closing-times.title: Clear publication and closing times
publication-closing-times.description: Each schedule states when the list will be published and until what time players can confirm presence.

moderator-management.title: Management available to Moderator+
moderator-management.description: Authorized users can create, edit, pause, reactivate, and monitor schedules from the settings area.

window-recovery.title: Recovery within the window
window-recovery.description: If the platform is temporarily unavailable, the list can still be created when service returns before closing.

duplicate-draft-protection.title: Duplicate list protection
duplicate-draft-protection.description: Each schedule and date creates at most one draft, even after restarts or simultaneous processing.

2026_07_1.title: More reliable drafts and Discord
2026_07_1.summary: Draft operations gained direct access, clearer confirmations, recoverable publications, and synchronized presence, along with stronger security and stability.

discord-draft-deep-link.title: Direct draft access from Discord
discord-draft-deep-link.description: Invitation links now open the matching draft automatically, removing manual selection from the list.

invalid-draft-link-feedback.title: Invalid link handling
invalid-draft-link-feedback.description: When a draft does not exist or is unavailable, the page explains the problem while keeping other drafts accessible.

contextual-admin-confirmations.title: Contextual admin confirmations
contextual-admin-confirmations.description: Cancellations, presence removals, and republications use integrated dialogs that explain context and impact before confirmation.

discord-publication-statuses.title: Separate publication statuses
discord-publication-statuses.description: Administrators can distinguish the presence list, role mention call, and final team publication states in Discord.

individual-publication-recovery.title: Individual failure recovery
individual-publication-recovery.description: Each failed publication can be recovered separately without repeating messages that were already delivered.

duplicate-message-protection.title: Duplicate message protection
duplicate-message-protection.description: Publications remain unique even during bot restarts or simultaneous execution.

realtime-presence.title: Realtime presence updates
realtime-presence.description: Confirmations, cancellations, and admin changes appear for everyone viewing the draft, including after reconnection.

consistent-presence-operations.title: More consistent presence operations
consistent-presence-operations.description: Repeated or simultaneous actions preserve one presence per player and return predictable outcomes.

eligible-player-search.title: More accurate manual player search
eligible-player-search.description: Search only shows eligible, unconfirmed players and discards stale results when the context changes.

admin-action-audit.title: More transparent admin actions
admin-action-audit.description: Cancellations, removals, manual additions, and republications record their reason and responsible user when applicable.

clear-bot-messages.title: Clearer bot messages
clear-bot-messages.description: Disabled configuration, invalid dates, and known failures receive specific guidance instead of generic responses.

discord-permission-diagnostics.title: Discord permission diagnostics
discord-permission-diagnostics.description: The bot distinguishes channel access, message, embed, and mention problems to make configuration easier to correct.

independent-presence-call.title: Independent presence call
independent-presence-call.description: The role mention call has its own state and recovery; a failure does not repeat or invalidate the main list.

resilient-publication-queue.title: More reliable publication queue
resilient-publication-queue.description: Pending publications continue processing across many drafts and after isolated failures elsewhere in the cycle.

security-stability-hardening.title: Internal security and stability hardening
security-stability-hardening.description: Stronger access protection, validation, and operational isolation make the platform safer and more predictable without changing how it is used.

2026_06_7.title: Security and visual identity
2026_06_7.summary: The platform advanced its protection, release readiness, operational visibility, and brand consistency.

security-baseline.title: Stronger security baseline
security-baseline.description: Preventive controls and secure standards now better protect internal workflows.

deployment-readiness.title: More predictable releases
deployment-readiness.description: Environment preparation and deployment checks reduce risk when shipping new versions.

operational-observability.title: Greater operational visibility
operational-observability.description: Operational signals and records help identify failures and monitor application health.

visual-identity.title: Consolidated visual identity
visual-identity.description: Screens and components gained a visual language that better reflects the competitive arena.

2026_06_6.title: Discord and presence confirmation
2026_06_6.summary: Linked accounts, shared presence, and team publication brought the workflow closer to the community channel.

discord-account-link.title: Linked Discord account
discord-account-link.description: Users can link Discord without losing traditional platform access.

shared-presence-list.title: Presence across Web and Discord
shared-presence-list.description: Confirmations and cancellations share the same official state across both channels.

presence-closing.title: Organized presence closing
presence-closing.description: The list can close at the scheduled time and prepare teams and reserves with clear rules.

final-teams-publication.title: Teams published to Discord
final-teams-publication.description: When the draft finishes, the community receives team rosters in the configured channel.

2026_06_5.title: Realtime draft
2026_06_5.summary: Captains and participants can follow picks, turns, and the official draft state without refreshing the page.

synchronized-picks.title: Synchronized picks
synchronized-picks.description: Each valid pick updates teams, available players, and history for every connected participant.

captain-turns.title: Captain turns
captain-turns.description: Only the current captain can pick, keeping the order fair and auditable.

turn-timer.title: Controlled turn timer
turn-timer.description: The clock keeps the draft moving and advances the turn when time expires.

reconnection-state.title: State restored after reconnection
reconnection-state.description: Returning viewers receive the current official state, including turn, teams, and previous picks.

2026_06_4.title: Accounts, permissions, and profiles
2026_06_4.summary: Authentication, access levels, and player links made participation safer and more personal.

account-access.title: Protected accounts and sessions
account-access.description: Registration, login, and sessions provide individual access to protected platform areas.

role-permissions.title: Responsibility-based permissions
role-permissions.description: Roles control admin actions while the server remains the source of truth for permissions.

player-profile-link.title: Account linked to player
player-profile-link.description: Each participant completes and maintains game details before joining drafts.

account-recovery.title: Account recovery
account-recovery.description: Password reset and change flows help users securely recover their own accounts.

2026_06_3.title: Visual team building
2026_06_3.summary: The draft began using registered players in a visual workspace with dynamic teams and reserves.

registered-player-pool.title: Registered draft players
registered-player-pool.description: Selection reuses the active roster and removes manual participant entry.

visual-team-building.title: Visual team building
visual-team-building.description: Players can be organized directly across areas and teams without duplication.

dynamic-teams-reserves.title: Dynamic teams and reserves
dynamic-teams-reserves.description: Participant count determines teams, required captains, and reserve players.

player-details.title: Player details during setup
player-details.description: Elo, roles, and game identities remain available without leaving the draft.

2026_06_2.title: Players, roles, and teams
2026_06_2.summary: Structured records replaced loose lists and created a reusable foundation for organizing the community.

player-directory.title: Player directory
player-directory.description: Profiles gather identity, elo, and useful links for lookup and organization.

route-preferences.title: Role preferences
route-preferences.description: Each player ranks the five roles and can indicate one role they prefer to avoid.

player-availability.title: Preserved availability history
player-availability.description: Inactive players remain in history while leaving new operational flows.

reusable-teams.title: Reusable teams
reusable-teams.description: Name, tag, captain, and roster remain saved for matches, drafts, and future lookup.

2026_06_1.title: Foundation and internationalization
2026_06_1.summary: Architecture standards, shared contracts, and bilingual catalogs established the platform foundation.

architecture-foundation.title: Architecture foundation
architecture-foundation.description: Clear layers and responsibilities prepared the application to grow with safe maintenance.

localized-interface.title: Portuguese and English interface
localized-interface.description: Navigation, pages, and messages began using synchronized translation catalogs.

shared-standards.title: Shared standards
shared-standards.description: Routes, constants, messages, and the development process gained verifiable conventions.
